s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent, severe, unilateral headaches with visual aura and refractory to multiple treatments
salient_findings: Unilateral headache with radiation to multiple regions
Refractory to multiple treatments including triptans and corticosteroids
key_facts: 17-year history of migraine headaches
Right-sided migraine with visual aura
Pain behind the right eye radiating to right frontal, temporal, and suboccipital regions
3 to 4 severe migraines per month lasting 3 to 7 days
Relief only from sumatriptan
Failed trials of acetaminophen, ibuprofen, rizatriptan, methylprednisolone, prednisone, and dexamethasone
Developed new headache pattern in January 2023
Failed treatment with ketorolac, rizatriptan, and dexamethasone taper
Failed treatment with naratriptan, prochlorperazine, acetaminophen, ibuprofen, and diphenhydramine
Unremarkable brain magnetic resonance imaging
Underwent ultrasound-guided right sphenopalatine ganglion block with bupivacaine and dexamethasone

shortlist.label: Chronic Migraine
shortlist.why_kept: 17-year history of migraine headaches, severe migraines with visual aura

shortlist.label: Hemicrania Continua
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral headache with refractory symptoms, failed treatments

shortlist.label: Cluster Headache
shortlist.why_kept: Severe, unilateral headaches with new pattern in January 2023

shortlist.label: Sphenopalatine Ganglion Neuralgia
shortlist.why_kept: Failed sphenopalatine ganglion block, persistent unilateral headache

raw.rationale: The patient's headache is characterized by a continuous, unilateral pain with ipsilateral autonomic symptoms, and it has not responded to various treatments, which is consistent with Hemicrania Continua.

rejected.label: Chronic Migraine
rejected.why: The patient's headache pattern changed in January 2023, and the pain is more continuous, which is not typical of Chronic Migraine.

rejected.label: Cluster Headache
rejected.why: The patient's headache does not occur in clusters or cycles, and it is not accompanied by restlessness or agitation, which are characteristic of Cluster Headache.

rejected.label: Medication Overuse Headache
rejected.why: The patient has tried various medications without relief, and the headache has not improved with withdrawal of these medications, which makes Medication Overuse Headache less likely.

rejected.label: Sphenopalatine Ganglion Neuralgia
rejected.why: The patient underwent an ultrasound-guided right sphenopalatine ganglion block with bupivacaine and dexamethasone, which failed to resolve her symptoms, making Sphenopalatine Ganglion Neuralgia less likely.
